info.name: Bank Security API
info.description:
Secure Banking Management System - security test collection (Tasks 10 to 39).

Before running:
1. Start the application with app.seed-test-users=true in application.properties (it creates ahmed, hacker, third, admin, manager and auditor, password Pass12345).
2. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner, in order; every test should be green. Folder 0 reads the ids of the test users automatically.

Each run creates fresh accounts, transfers and a custom role, so it can be repeated.
Not automated (needs a database change): login for a customer with no roles (expects 401).

item.name: 0 - Setup (reads the ids of the seeded test users)
[201] Register new customer (email lower-cased, role CUSTOMER, no password)

exec: pm.test("Role is CUSTOMER only", function () { pm.expect(j.roles).to.eql(["CUSTOMER"]); });

item.name: [404] Valid login passes the filter chain (account does not exist)
[401] GET /auth/register without auth (only POST is public)
[403] Unlisted path as ahmed (deny by default)

exec: pm.test("12-digit number, ACTIVE, EGP, balance 1000", function () { pm.expect(j.accountNumber).to.match(/^\d{12}$/); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("ACTIVE"); pm.expect(j.currency).to.eql("EGP"); pm.expect(Number(j.balance)).to.eql(1000); });

item.name: [201] Admin creates account Z (zero balance, used for update/delete tests)
[409] Delete account with balance is refused
[200] admin reads customer (no password in response)

exec: pm.test("Roles is an array", function () { pm.expect(j.roles).to.be.an("array"); });

item.name: [200] admin updates customer (extra email field is ignored)
[201] ahmed creates transfer A to B (PENDING)

exec: pm.test("PENDING, amount 200, createdBy is ahmed", function () { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("PENDING"); pm.expect(Number(j.amount)).to.eql(200); pm.expect(j.createdById).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("ahmedId"))); });

pm.test("Contains the 10 base permissions", function () { pm.expect(j.map(function (p) { return p.name; })).to.include.members(["ACCOUNT_READ", "ACCOUNT_CREATE", "ACCOUNT_UPDATE", "ACCOUNT_DELETE", "TRANSFER_CREATE", "TRANSFER_READ", "TRANSFER_APPROVE", "CUSTOMER_READ", "CUSTOMER_UPDATE", "REPORT_VIEW"]); });

pm.test("Status is one of [201, 409]", function () { pm.expect([201, 409]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
